ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (scars/barnacles) to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense white contiguous blobs at the distal tips of both lobes; numerous fine white linear and circular motifs distributed across the dark field, primarily concentrated on the left lobe and central trailing edge regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped indentation with an estimated convergence angle of 40 degrees and significant pixel depth relative to the lobe longitudinal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jaggedness; left lobe trailing edge displays prominent serrations with pixel-amplitudes between 5-15 pixels; right lobe displays lower-frequency irregularity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge sweep on both lobes; trailing edge exhibits a broad concave arc from distal tips towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters at the distal tips (barnacle colonization); smaller circular white clusters scattered across the ventral surface, notably in the upper-left quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths and orientations, predominantly concentrated on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface rake marks and distinct barnacle colonization clusters at the distal lobe tips.
